journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

articles.title_en: Do factor models capture both sentiment and limited attention?
articles.title_cn: 因子模型能否同时捕捉情绪与有限关注？
articles.abstract_en: We demonstrate that valuation uncertainty and information arrival are critical stock characteristics determining whether individual factors in leading factor models are influenced by sentiment or limited attention. Therefore, the ability of a factor model to explain cross-sectional stock returns depends on including two distinct types of factors: those that capture sentiment and those that tackle limited attention. Yet, many leading factor models include factors for sentiment but fall short in incorporating factors for limited attention. Our findings are important, guiding future research towards developing new factor models that more effectively capture both sentiment and limited attention compared to existing models. This includes uncovering powerful factors capable of simultaneously capturing sentiment and limited attention.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们证明，估值不确定性和信息到达是决定领先因子模型中各因子是否受情绪或有限关注影响的关键股票特征。因此，因子模型解释横截面股票收益的能力取决于是否包含两类不同的因子：一类捕捉情绪，另一类应对有限关注。然而，许多领先因子模型包含了情绪因子，但在纳入有限关注因子方面存在不足。我们的发现具有重要意义，指导未来研究朝着开发比现有模型更有效捕捉情绪和有限关注的新因子模型方向发展，包括发现能够同时捕捉情绪和有限关注的强大因子。

articles.title_cn: 需求侧实际刚性再探讨
articles.abstract_en: This study explores the mechanism behind the persistent effects of monetary policy shocks, resolving a discrepancy between an assumption in typical macroeconomic models and micro evidence. While standard macro models often rely on a large demand kink (a micro real rigidity) to generate persistent real effects of monetary policy shocks, micro-empirical studies find this kink to be modest. I show that this discrepancy can be resolved by focusing on a previously underexplored interaction: the effects of this modest, empirically consistent micro real rigidity are amplified when combined with the macro real rigidities inherent in production linkages. A stylized production-chain model first clarifies the mechanism, showing how upstream micro rigidities are transformed into downstream macro rigidities. A large-scale production-network model, disciplined by empirical data, then demonstrates that this combined mechanism is quantitatively important for macroeconomic persistence.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了货币政策冲击持续性效应背后的机制，解决了典型宏观经济模型中的假设与微观证据之间的差异。标准宏观模型通常依赖较大的需求拐点（一种微观实际刚性）来产生货币政策冲击的持续性实际效应，而微观实证研究发现该拐点较为温和。我表明，通过关注一个先前未被充分探索的相互作用，可以解决这一差异：当这种温和的、与实证一致的微观实际刚性结合生产关联中固有的宏观实际刚性时，其效应会被放大。一个简化的生产链模型首先阐明了该机制，展示了上游微观刚性如何转化为下游宏观刚性。随后，一个由实证数据约束的大规模生产网络模型证明，这种组合机制对宏观经济持续性具有定量上的重要性。

articles.title_en: Matching friction, coordination, and monetary nonneutrality
articles.title_cn: 匹配摩擦、协调与货币非中性
articles.abstract_en: This paper theoretically and experimentally investigates matching friction as a cause of monetary nonneutrality. We design a price-posting game in which mismatching (i.e., a player not being matched with a trading partner) is costly and can only be eliminated if players coordinate on one equilibrium from a specific subset of multiple equilibria. In the lab, subjects coordinate by certain pricing and visiting rules, and their actions appear to be consistent with such an equilibrium. A nominal shock disturbs the established coordination patterns and, in particular, causes sellers to adjust their pricing rules. The adjustment is persistent and differs at a disaggregate level in a way that the resulting nonneutrality gets along with the quantity theory (i.e., the aggregate price level is proportional to the aggregate nominal stock).
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过理论和实验研究匹配摩擦作为货币非中性的一个原因。我们设计了一个价格发布博弈，其中错配（即玩家未与交易伙伴匹配）是有成本的，并且只有当玩家在多个均衡的特定子集上协调一致时才能消除。在实验室中，受试者通过特定的定价和访问规则进行协调，他们的行为似乎与这样的均衡一致。名义冲击扰乱了既定的协调模式，特别是导致卖方调整其定价规则。这种调整是持久的，并且在分解层面上有所不同，使得由此产生的非中性符合数量理论（即总体价格水平与总体名义存量成比例）。

articles.title_en: Inside money, fraud and self-fulfilling liquidity dry-up
articles.title_cn: 内部货币、欺诈与自我实现的流动性枯竭
articles.abstract_en: I study the efficiency of issuing inside money under the risk of fraud in a competitive equilibrium. In the model, bankers can issue money with their franchise values and/or by holding real assets, but they can also fake the quality of the asset at a proportional cost. When the supply of assets is scarce and the counterfeiting cost is intermediate, multiple equilibria can arise with a self-fulfilling liquidity dry-up, where the haircut in the collateral transaction increases and aggregate liquidity shrinks simultaneously. This equilibrium allocation is suboptimal because the individual bankers cannot internalize the effect of issuing money on the prices and the pledgeability of the assets in general equilibrium. We find that imposing an entry cost is more effective in correcting pecuniary externality because the counterfeiting incentive can be discouraged by a positive franchise value. Maximum haircut requirements have an advantage of eliminating a self-fulfilling liquidity dry-up.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了在竞争均衡中，面临欺诈风险时发行内部货币的效率。在模型中，银行家可以利用其特许经营权价值和/或持有实物资产来发行货币，但他们也可以按比例成本伪造资产质量。当资产供给稀缺且伪造成本处于中等水平时，可能会出现多重均衡，伴随自我实现的流动性枯竭，此时抵押品交易中的折扣率上升，同时总流动性收缩。这种均衡配置是次优的，因为个体银行家无法在一般均衡中内化发行货币对资产价格和可质押性的影响。我们发现，征收进入成本在纠正货币外部性方面更为有效，因为正的特许经营权价值可以抑制伪造激励。最高折扣率要求具有消除自我实现的流动性枯竭的优势。

articles.title_en: The “digital” premium: Why does digitalization drive stock returns?
articles.title_cn: “数字化”溢价：数字化为何驱动股票回报？
articles.abstract_en: To explore whether the rise of digital innovation across firms might point to the existence of a new risk compensation in asset pricing, we construct a text-based measure of the socio-technical phenomenon of digitalization, called digital orientation, by using the MD&A section of annual firm reports from 1996 to 2020. We find that firms with a high digital orientation (digital leaders) are systematically different along several key characteristics like valuation, sales growth, and profitability, forming a peer group of digitally leading firms across traditional industry boundaries. A digital orientation strategy, which is long (short) stocks with high (low) digital orientation, earns an equally weighted (value-weighted) monthly six-factor alpha of 0.41 % (0.28 %) per month, both statistically significant at 5 %. These results are robust to various sensitivity checks, including alternative constructions of the digital orientation measure, controls for industry membership, changes to the sample dataset, and the use of an alternative dictionary. Additionally, the results remain comparable if we construct an alternative investment strategy based on the portfolio holdings of funds with a digital innovation focus.
articles.abstract_cn: 为探究企业数字化创新的兴起是否可能预示着资产定价中存在新的风险补偿，我们利用1996年至2020年公司年度报告的MD&A部分，构建了一个基于文本的数字化社会技术现象度量指标，称为数字化导向。我们发现，具有高数字化导向的企业（数字化领导者）在估值、销售增长和盈利能力等若干关键特征上系统性不同，形成了跨越传统行业边界的数字化领先企业同行群体。一种数字化导向策略，即做多（做空）高（低）数字化导向的股票，每月等权重（价值加权）六因子阿尔法为0.41%（0.28%），两者在5%的水平上统计显著。这些结果对各种敏感性检验均稳健，包括数字化导向指标的替代构建、行业归属控制、样本数据集变更以及替代词典的使用。此外，如果我们基于具有数字化创新重点的基金投资组合构建替代投资策略，结果仍然可比。

articles.title_en: Private versus social responses to a pandemic
articles.title_cn: 疫情中的私人与社会应对
articles.abstract_en: What are the socially optimal restrictions on private activity during a pandemic? How do these differ from private decisions? We address these questions by modeling the interactions between epidemiology and the macroeconomy. Unlike the private planner, the social planner accounts for two externalities: the increase in the cost of severe illness associated with more infected individuals, reflecting the capacity constraints of the health care system; and the socioeconomic transmission of the virus from asymptomatic to susceptible individuals. Owing to these externalities, the social planner imposes stricter constraints on socioeconomic activities. Applied to the COVID-19 pandemic, socially optimal restrictions reduce the welfare costs by roughly one percent of GDP.
articles.abstract_cn: 在疫情期间，对社会最优的私人活动限制是什么？这些限制与私人决策有何不同？我们通过模拟流行病学与宏观经济之间的相互作用来探讨这些问题。与私人规划者不同，社会规划者考虑两种外部性：一是感染者增多导致的重症成本上升，反映了医疗系统的容量限制；二是病毒从无症状感染者向易感人群的社会经济传播。由于这些外部性，社会规划者对 socioeconomic 活动施加了更严格的限制。应用于 COVID-19 疫情，社会最优限制将福利成本降低了约 GDP 的百分之一。

articles.title_en: Unemployment and labor productivity comovement: the role of firm exit
articles.title_cn: 失业与劳动生产率联动：企业退出的作用
articles.abstract_en: The Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides model has been the primary workhorse for analyzing the dynamics of unemployment, vacancies, and market tightness over the business cycle. However, it predicts a near-perfect comovement between these variables and labor productivity, whereas the empirical correlation is only mild. We resolve this discrepancy by extending the model to incorporate sunk entry costs and finitely elastic vacancy creation, and by carefully distinguishing between business opportunity destruction and match separation as distinct sources of job loss. These features render vacancies a partially predetermined, positively valued stock variable. If the destruction rate is low, then most vacancies are inherited from the past and reflect historical rather than current productivity, breaking the tight unemployment-productivity link, while preserving strong correlations among labor market variables. We show that, when calibrated to information on job turnover and recall rates, the model reproduces the empirical contemporaneous and dynamic correlations between labor market variables and productivity while preserving the strong correlation between unemployment, vacancies, and the market tightness observed in the data.
articles.abstract_cn: Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides模型一直是分析商业周期中失业、职位空缺和市场紧度动态的主要工具。然而，该模型预测这些变量与劳动生产率之间存在近乎完美的联动，而实证相关性仅为温和。我们通过扩展模型以纳入沉没进入成本和有限弹性的职位创造，并仔细区分商业机会破坏与匹配分离作为失业的不同来源，解决了这一差异。这些特征使职位空缺成为部分预定、正值的存量变量。如果破坏率较低，那么大多数职位空缺是从过去继承的，反映的是历史而非当前的生产率，从而打破了失业与生产率之间的紧密联系，同时保持了劳动力市场变量之间的强相关性。我们表明，当根据职位流动和召回率的信息进行校准后，该模型再现了劳动力市场变量与生产率之间的实证同期和动态相关性，同时保持了数据中观察到的失业、职位空缺和市场紧度之间的强相关性。

articles.title_en: Better late than never: Macroeconomic impact of intermittent college enrollment and tuition subsidies
articles.title_cn: 迟做总比不做好：间歇性大学入学与学费补贴的宏观经济影响
articles.abstract_en: People often delay starting college or temporarily leave college to work. To examine the welfare implications of intermittent college attendance, I incorporate flexible age-by-age college enrollment choice in a life-cycle model in general equilibrium. College serves as an investment device for the young and reduces risk for the old. Removing flexible access reduces the total welfare value of college by one quarter. Moreover, higher wealth and better human capital preparedness at age 18 incentivize early-age degree completion. However, accessing college at a later age matters more for those who are initially less advantaged. Thus, policies that alleviate financial costs generate considerable long-term welfare improvements.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们常常推迟开始大学学业或暂时离开大学去工作。为了考察间歇性大学出勤的福利影响，我在一般均衡的生命周期模型中纳入了灵活的逐年龄大学入学选择。大学对年轻人而言是一种投资工具，并降低了老年人的风险。取消灵活入学机会会使大学的总福利价值减少四分之一。此外，在18岁时更高的财富和更好的人力资本准备会激励早期完成学位。然而，对于初始条件较差的人来说，在较晚年龄进入大学更为重要。因此，缓解财务成本的政策能产生可观的长期福利改善。
